gaps.explanation: Nothing is missing. p5 prints one debt row: General 'Proceeds from Inception of Lease' 54,065 (JSON debt_proceeds), already in detail[] as General Fund 'Proceeds from Issuance of Lease' 54,065 (p10). The schedule total 150,605 also counts the budget schedules' sale-of-asset lines, which are not debt: Fire Fund Proceeds from sale of capital assets 21,927 (p21), All America City TIF Fund Proceeds from sale of capital assets 43,296 and Proceeds from Sale of Uncapitalized Assets 31,317 (p21); 54,065 + 21,927 + 43,296 + 31,317 = 150,605. The statement carries the sales in other_financing 65,224 (Sale of Land Held for Resale 43,297 + Sale of Uncapitalized Assets 21,927, p5); the budget schedule's extra 31,317 (and 1 rounding, 43,296 vs 43,297) is budgetary vs GAAP presentation. All other-financing rows printed on p5 are in detail[]. No fix.
